pins.kicker: Stuck on a gift for a hiker?
pins.title: Useful hiker gifts
pins.sub: Wool socks, a headlamp, a paper map or a hike together. Practical ideas from free to $80, sorted by budget.

pins.kicker: Gift for a hiker with big plans?
pins.title: A year of goals
pins.sub: A 2027 hike-a-week planner, a peak bagger's logbook and a national parks tracker. Printable, so you can give it today.

pins.title: Pocket trail log
pins.sub: One sheet, three folds, one cut: an 8-page mini hiking journal that fits a shirt pocket. Print as many as you like.

pins.title: Ready for dark
pins.sub: A USB-C headlamp, a neck gaiter and our Winter Hiking Guide in one set. Short days end in the dark: light the way back.

pins.title: Plan the trip
pins.sub: Three printable trip guides: the Smokies, Utah's Mighty 5 and Yellowstone & Grand Teton. Itineraries, day hikes and packing lists.

pins.title: Switch to merino
pins.sub: Merino stays warm when it gets damp and resists odor. Ours are 80% merino with a cushioned sole, sold as one pair.

pins.title: Wash them cool
pins.sub: Inside out, on a cool wool cycle or by hand. No bleach, no tumble dryer. Dry them flat to keep the shape.

pins.kicker: Filter straw hard to drink from?
pins.title: Soak, then sip
pins.sub: A new straw needs its membrane soaked first. If it slowly gets harder, backflush it with clean water. Never let it freeze while wet.

pins.kicker: A gift of time, not stuff?
pins.title: Hike together
pins.sub: 44 printable hike coupons, a trail pass and a gift certificate. Print it and give it today.

pins.title: Scavenger hunts
pins.sub: 12 printable trail scavenger hunts for every season, trail bingo and a junior hiker journal for ages 4 to 10.
